unit.why: An anecdote: on the second day of Pesach the young rebbe grows angry at hasidim for drinking, they complain to R. Moshe, and he explains his anger kabbalistically.

stories.start_quote: סיפר לי הגאוה״ק ריוס״מ שליט״א מספינקא
stories.summary_en: In his youth at the court of his uncle and master R. Moshe, the rebbe grew angry at hasidim who drank much on the second day of Pesach; when they complained, he explained that his anger, an aspect of gevurah, drew down the first portion of the mohin of hokhmah through the Omer count, and R. Moshe accepted it.
